necessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
necessary.text: These are essential for the website to work (for example, remembering your cookie choices) and cannot be switched off.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.text: We use Google Analytics to place and read cookies for the above purposes. We have configured Google Analytics to protect your privacy: the last octet of your IP address is anonymised and data sharing with Google is turned off.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.text: These help us measure how our ads perform (Meta, Google) and show you relevant offers. Without them you will still see ads, but less relevant ones.
